evidence.claim: Bisazza nasce nel 1956 ad Alte di Vicenza e riveste facciate di edifici pubblici, residenziali e commerciali con una rete di 2.800 rivenditori.
evidence.quote: Established by Renato Bisazza in 1956 in Alte, Vicenza, Northern Italy, the company has become a trailblazer, marked by a dynamic entrepreneurial spirit, a mastery of modern technologies, and an ability to read and anticipate the needs of the global market || The company's distribution network currently includes 4 flagship stores in London, Milan, New York and Paris and 2,800 local retailers around the world || cladding the facades of public, residential and commercial buildings in Italy and France
